subject: The submarine unit's own behaviour: the leaf class layout and its two ticks, the four-band depth state machine and its command arms, the air-supply and crush-depth rules, the periscope state machine including the broken state, and the contract by which the depth target reaches the hull physics. Ghidra was read-only for this packet: no renames, no comments, no prototypes, no saves.
reuses: include/bsp/sensor_tables.hpp for SensorCategory; 00852B90's band boundaries stay there and this packet only produces the periscopeOut byte it reads
include/bsp/gameplay_settings.hpp already names every Submarine.* setting this model reads; docs/GAMEPLAY_SETTINGS.md carries their installed values
include/bsp/ship_class_fields.hpp for MaxSpeed +500h, KamikazeDamage +510h and KamikazeBlastDamage +514h
include/bsp/vehicle_class_fields.hpp for Length +A0h, Width +A4h and Height +A8h
docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_LAYOUT.md for the six-level constructor chain the submarine leaf joins at level 5
docs/SHIP_MOTION.md, which already listed 0085542F as an unidentified override call site of 00825F20
verification_note: Rule 2 of docs/WORKER_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md cannot be satisfied for five of the routines below: Ghidra has no function at 00854650, 00855420, 00852C60, 00853E10 or 00852D30, so tools/verify_report_calls.py rejects every site inside them with 'call site is in no Ghidra function'. Their rows are therefore carried under calls_unverifiable with site/callee keys rather than address/native, so the checker runs clean over the rows it can actually check. Every site in those lists was read from a bsp.py disasm-raw dump of the disk bytes and its containing routine established from the int3 padding boundaries listed under no_ghidra_function, not from a scroll position.

functions.name: BSP_SubmarineUnit_StepAirSupply
functions.note: The breathing line is bands[1] + 3.0 (00D7A2B0, a double) discarded whenever it falls below zero: 00855266-00855286 is FCOMIP of 0.0 against the sum with JBE keeping the sum, so every shipped class (periscope depth around -20) gets the flat -4.0 of 00CF1430 and the boat must come nearly to the surface to breathe. Submerged: air -= dt / class.AirRunOutTime (+838h, default 120.0). Surfaced: air += dt / class.AirReloadTime (+83Ch, default 5.0). unlimitedAir (+1280h) skips the whole submerged block, warnings included. Both warnings are downward edges only and the critical edge at SubmarineAirNeedLimit 0.16 suppresses the low edge at SubmarineAirWarningLimit 0.35 on a step that crosses both. air clamps to 1.0, and a negative air with unit+5Dh clear zeroes the field and then destroys the boat. The needAir latch arms below 0.16 and disarms above SubmarineAirEnoughLimit 0.5, and the native returns straight after arming so the disarm test is skipped that step.

functions.name: BSP_SubmarineUnit_StepCrushDepthDamage
functions.note: +1284h accumulates dt and the sum is stored back at 008551c6 before the test, so the field carries the un-pulsed remainder between pulses. Once the accumulator passes 1.0 (008551dd COMISS, strict >), a hull Y below -SubmarineDamageDepth (+4B0h, installed 70.0) takes SubmarineDepthDamage (+4ACh, installed 9.0) times the accumulated interval, then the accumulator zeroes. The limit is a global gameplay setting and never a class key, so every submarine in the game crushes at the same 70 metres and SwimDepth3 only bounds what the player can order; a class whose SwimDepth3 is shallower than 70 never crushes under its own commands. The pose refresh is inside the branch, so the hull Y is read only on a pulse.

functions.name: BSP_SubmarineUnit_SEntityInit
functions.coverage: partial: the depth-band table, the initial band and the periscope setup are established; the waterflow and waterdistortion effect setup 00853659-008539d4 is read only for the fields it writes
functions.note: main vtable slot +A0h over 00822C20 BSP_UnitInstance_SEntityInit, which it calls first. Builds the four depth bands into +1200h..+120Ch in the loop at 00853A90-00853AC5: band 0 always takes the default table (00853A90 CMP EDI,EBX with EBX zero then JLE), and bands 1..3 take -0.0 (DAT_00D7A208) minus the class key when the key is non-negative (00853A9F COMISS then JB), otherwise the default. The four defaults are the dwords at 00E0B578, 0.0, -20.0, -40.0 and -80.0; 00853A63 loads that address and 00853A7B subtracts 80Ch so the table can be indexed by the class offset, which is why a Ghidra label appears at 00E0AD6C. Picks the initial band from the kamikaze test, then the scene property bag keys Dive (00D0B6A4, which also teleports the entity by writing bands[level] into its local Y at +A8h, clearing +C8h and +10Ch and invalidating every child pose) and TargetDive, then the nearest band by |hullY - bands[i]| over i = 1..3 with |hullY| as band 0's incumbent error and a strict < at 00853b9e so ties keep the shallower band. Looks the periscope node up by name unless the class is kamikaze, stores its rest local Y as periscopeY, allocates a 6Ch object at +1224h and reads the periscope_sight marker triple into +1218h..+1220h (default 0, 10.0, 0 from DAT_00CE38B8).

functions.name: BSP_SubmarineController_StepDepthPhysics
functions.coverage: partial: the effective-band resolution, the seabed clamp, the depth-curve inputs and the velocity writeback are established; the sullyesztoEro slew at 009371c1-00937398 is not, because the decompiler reports unaff_EBX and unaff_retaddr there and the sign and speed term were not settled from the listing
functions.note: the submarine's force model. Its only reference is the vtable dword at 00D196EC, the slot before 00937440, which docs/SHIP_MOTION.md establishes as the ship's force model reached as controller->vtable[0](dt); the literal s_fizika sits at 00D196E0 immediately before the table. controller+1Ch is the unit and unit+1018h is the controller, which 00855498 and 00854ec3 both confirm by passing it to named controller routines. Overrides the commanded band twice: needAir or the catapult rule force band 0 unless the class is kamikaze, and unit+5Dh (dead) forces band 3, which is how a wreck sinks. Clamps the target up to the scan output +123Ch and raises the depth-curve gain from 1.0 to 1.5 (DAT_00CE380C) when it does, and when clamped writes two more curve results into the order-ring slots at unit + 844h + unit[97Ch]*20h and +848h. The contract: sullyesztoEro is subtracted from the body's velocity Y and written back through the two DYN physics calls below, and nothing else in the submarine module touches the physics body.

functions.name: BSP_SubmarineUnit_HandleMessage
functions.note: main vtable slot +164h over 00821E80 BSP_UnitInstance_HandleMessage, which handles kinds 4Bh..A0h; the submarine adds exactly the two kinds above that ceiling. Kind A1h steps the band: the payload byte at msg+20h zero means deeper (level+1 when level < 3) and non-zero means shallower (level-1 when level > 0), and a clamped step still answers AL = 1 without calling the setter. Kind A2h sets the band absolutely from the dword at msg+20h. Anything else rewrites [ESP+4] at 00852c74 and tail-jumps to the base.

flow_gaps.note: No flow gaps. The long undefined bodies were taken from bsp.py disasm-raw over the disk bytes rather than ghidra disasm, so no instruction runs could be silently dropped after a free-class call; consecutive listed addresses were checked for holes across 00854650-008551b9 (743 instructions), 00855420-00855937 (325) and 00853e10-00854222 (297) and every instruction boundary is contiguous. The only int3 runs inside the region are the real padding at 008551ba, 00852cbc, 00852cf1, 00852fae, 00853005, 00853018 and 00854223, each of which is a function boundary.

corrections.is: The producers are now named. The four depth words at unit+1200h..+120Ch are built once at scene attach by 00853630's loop at 00853A90-00853AC5 from the class keys PeriscopeDepth, SwimDepth2 and SwimDepth3 against a default table of 0.0, -20.0, -40.0, -80.0 at 00E0B578; band 0 is always the default. build: ./scripts/build.ps1 clean, Win32 Release, warnings as errors; ctest reconstructed_math passed with one added case pinning the air model's suppressed low edge, its latch skip and the -4.0 breathing line
open_questions: The sign and speed term of the sullyesztoEro slew at 009371c1-00937398. The decompiler loses both register inputs and the listing was not read instruction by instruction, so the reconstruction stops at the commanded rate.
The 13 sample points of the seabed ring. The arms are combinations of -0.0, Width, 2*Width and Length, and three of them are pure x87 rotations, but the ring's shape was not derived.
Why 00977500 is dead. Either the break path lost its report during development or a caller was removed; nothing in the image distinguishes the two.
class +828h UpDownRotation has no reader in anything this packet read. It is loaded by 00854230 and never used here.
class +820h sits inside the submarine key range and no Lua key writes it.
unit+1279h, the catapult surface enable, is written at 0085420a in the serializer tail and read by 008522c0 and three ship-AI sites; the condition behind the serializer store was not read.

No installed per-class values are quoted anywhere in this packet: the class Lua rows live in the packed archives, which are out of scope here. Only the binary's own defaults and the installed global gameplay settings are given.
tool_problems: ghidra xrefs and ghidra callers both answered 'No callers found for function: null' for 00855250 and 008551c0 because their caller 00855420 has no Ghidra function; xrefs still gave the raw sites, which is what located the tick.

ghidra proto on an address inside an undefined region answers '? ? body ?' with no indication of the nearest function, so every boundary in the five undefined bodies had to be established from int3 padding in a disasm-raw dump.
bsp.py ghidra disasm rejects --length, so the raw dumps went through bsp.py disasm-raw with a driver script at local/dump_region.py.

Capstone's x87 operand order for FSUBR is ambiguous in the raw listing: the dump printed 'fsubr st(1)' at 00854f10 for the bytes D8 E9, which is FSUBR ST(0),ST(1) and computes ST(0) = ST(1) - ST(0), the opposite of what the printed form suggests. The auto-raise window was wrong until the bytes were read.
rg is not on PATH in the PowerShell tool; the Grep tool was used instead.

verify_report_calls.py has no way to express a call site inside a routine Ghidra has no function for: it fails such a row unconditionally, so the five undefined routines' rows had to be moved out of the checked key names. See verification_note.
